title: v0.4.2: restore Enigmatic spellstone + correct Dungeon Difficulty path, broaden mobs and retry early zone scaling
head: experimental/v042-spellstone-dungeon-difficulty-combined-20261011
body:
## From live feedback
User screenshot comparison shows one Enigmatic spellstone Curios slot missing (new version has only one of final two slots). In the 330-mod Many-Fix candidate, Dungeon Difficulty buffs affected only a minority of dungeon mobs; in a second Dungeon Crawl dungeon there were no observable buffs; some mobs showed 2 current HP. User reports other fixes working.

## Root causes confirmed in source
1. Enigmatic Legacy Plus 1.1.2 `ELCuriosDataProvider` defines `spellstone` slot `size(0)` with its original `enigmaticlegacyplus:slot/empty_spellstone_slot` icon; prior AO Paxi bridge only guaranteed the `amulet` slot. Add a non-replacing `spellstone` slot size 1 through the **compiler** so regeneration cannot discard it. Keep both slots and original Enigmatic item tags.
2. **Critical configuration packaging bug:** prior `tools/package_v042_manyfix.py` wrote `overrides/config/dungeon_difficulty_v2.json`, but the Dungeon Difficulty 3.9.2 1.21.1 mod uses `ConfigManager("difficulty_v2").setDirectory("dungeon_difficulty")`, i.e. `overrides/config/dungeon_difficulty/difficulty_v2.json`. The previous intended six-zone pilot was ignored. Fix path and fail the final ZIP for any legacy location.
3. Pilot filter matched *only vanilla mob IDs*. Expand to explicitly selected ordinary modded hostiles (Born In Chaos, Illager Invasion, Rotten Creatures, Creeper Overhaul and Dungeon Crawl), with strong regex negative boss selectors and existing attitude HOSTILE.
4. Native Dungeon Difficulty's `ServerEntityManagerMixin.onAddEntity` evaluates at insertion even if structure starts/references have not been populated, then stores an `evaluated in dimension` sentinel and does not retry. New AO worldgen safety `0.1.3-experimental` has a narrow server-thread `EntityJoinLevelEvent` late retry (at 10 ticks and at most one 40-tick retry), using reflection only when Dungeon Difficulty is installed. It clears only the no-zone sentinel and calls the **native** `EntityScaling.scale`. Never alters already-scaled entities, runs on worldgen worker, loops per tick, or heals mods' health unconditionally.

## Exact combined pack
- Inherits [recipe/spawner/Q PR #31](https://github.com/alsynth/AmbientOdyssey/pull/31): 15 original Mine Cells recipe conversions, four conservative recipe disables, Dungeon Crawl pending block entity persistence and single native empty trade correction, Questlog Q 0.1.3, previous Curios/FTB, Mine Cells/Streams and TREK/Create changes. Three AO add-ons, exact 330 locked third-party mods including Dungeon Difficulty, no rollback modifications.
- Strict native ZIP validation requires both amulet/spellstone JSON, correct nested DD config with six structure zones, exact mod counts and 0.1.3 worldgen addon class for late retry. [Fast source regression](https://github.com/alsynth/AmbientOdyssey/actions/runs/38151916712) PASS.
